definitions.explanation: Used to set aside complications or details and focus on the main point or immediate action. Expresses 'regardless of other considerations'.
Used to introduce a conclusion or decision when the speaker wants to move past uncertainties.

examples.japanese: とにかく⟦{試|ため}して→試す：02130_tamesu⟧⟦みよう→見る：00283_miru⟧。
⟦{理由|りゆう}→理由：01102_riyuu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦わからない→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、とにかく⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{怒|おこ}っている→怒る：00876_okoru⟧。
examples.english: I don't know the reason, but at any rate, he's angry.

examples.japanese: とにかく⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{休|やす}んで→休む：00606_yasumu⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: In any case, please rest for now.

examples.japanese: とにかく⟦{電話|でんわ}→電話：01471_denwa⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦みよう→見る：00283_miru⟧。
とにかく⟦{安全|あんぜん}→安全：01131_anzen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一番|いちばん}→一番：01140_ichiban⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: At any rate, safety is the most important thing.

examples.japanese: とにかく⟦{食|た}べて→食べる：00396_taberu⟧⟦みて→見る：00283_miru⟧。
とにかく⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: In any case, the results are in.

examples.japanese: とにかく⟦{急|いそ}いで→急ぐ：01191_isogu⟧！
とにかく⟦やって→やる：02980_yaru⟧⟦みなければ→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦わからない→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧。
examples.english: At any rate, you won't know until you try.

examples.japanese: とにかく⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{無事|ぶじ}→無事：01602_buji⟧⟦だった→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: In any case, he was safe.

cross_references.label: for now, for the time being

notes:
USAGE:
とにかく sets aside complications or uncertainty to focus on the main point or the immediate step: "don't overthink it; let's just do this first". It often comes before a suggestion or command (とにかく⟦{試|ため}して→試す：02130_tamesu⟧みよう) or before a conclusion that holds whatever else is true (とにかく⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{無事|ぶじ}→無事：01602_buji⟧だった).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- とにかく〜てみる (let's just try ~)
- とにかく〜だ (at any rate, ~ is the case)
- とにかく⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ (for now, at least)

WRITING:
Can also be written {兎に角|とにかく}, but hiragana is more common.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ともかく→ともかく：06780_tomokaku⟧: essentially the same, slightly more formal; also 〜⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ともかく→ともかく：06780_tomokaku⟧ (setting ~ aside)
- ⟦いずれにせよ→いずれにせよ：06779_izureniseyo⟧: in any case (more formal)
- ⟦{何|なに}→何：00498_nani⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ともあれ→ともあれ：07337_tomoare⟧: in any case, first of all
- ⟦さて→さて：01611_sate⟧おき: setting aside
